posts.title: The key to keeping the internet alive might be anticheats
posts.description: The Dead Internet Theory is a concept asserting that the internet consists primarily of bots and automated content[1], an idea that has gotten ever more popular since the boom of Artificial Intelligence, however, I don't think it's quite true. At the time of writing, 58.7% of the requests to HTML files passing through Cloudflare's network are initiated by bots[2], these are most certainly crawlers
